accepted.question_text: Let τ(n,t)=\frac{1}{n}\left(t-(t+n+1)\left(\frac{t}{1+t}\right)^{n+1}\right) for positive integers n and real numbers t>0. What is the maximum value of τ(n,t) over all pairs (n,t)\in \mathbb{N}\times(0,\infty)?
accepted.context_brief: Maximum of a gamma-function-related auxiliary expression
